nights.title: Eivør
nights.name: Eivør
nights.extract: Eivør Pálsdóttir, known mononymously as Eivør, is a Faroese singer-songwriter. Born and raised in Syðrugøta, she had her first televised performance at the age of 13. Over the course of her decades-long career, her musical output has spanned a wide range of genres such as folk, art pop, jazz, folk rock, classical and electronica.

en.who: Eivør Pálsdóttir, known mononymously as Eivør, is a Faroese singer-songwriter. Over a decades-long career her music has spanned many genres.

facts: In Syðrugøta geboren und aufgewachsen, hatte sie im alter von 13 jahren ihren ersten fernsehauftritt.
Ihre musik hat sich durch genres wie folk, art pop, jazz, folk rock, klassik und elektronik bewegt.

nights.title: The Mountain Goats - Night Five: Cast of Thousands
nights.name: The Mountain Goats
nights.extract: The Mountain Goats are an American indie folk band formed in Claremont, California, by singer-songwriter John Darnielle. Since 2003, the band has been based in Durham, North Carolina. For many years, the sole member of the Mountain Goats was Darnielle, despite the plural moniker. Although he remains the core member of the band, he has worked with a variety of collaborators over time, including bassist and vocalist Peter Hughes, drummer Jon Wurster, multi-instrumentalist Matt Douglas, singer-songwriter Franklin Bruno, bassist and vocalist Rachel Ware, singer-songwriter/producer John Vanderslice, guitarist Kaki King, and multi-instrumentalist Annie Clark.

en.kicker: american indie folk band · durham, north carolina
en.who: The Mountain Goats are an American indie folk band. For many years John Darnielle was the sole member, despite the plural name. He has since worked with a variety of collaborators.

Since 2003, the band has been based in Durham, North Carolina.

facts: Die band wurde von singer-songwriter John Darnielle in Claremont, Kalifornien, gegründet.

nights.title: Spencer Day
nights.name: Spencer Day
nights.extract: Spencer Day is a modern jazz singer and songwriter best known for his hit Jazz single "Till You Come to Me" as well as appearing on the CBS television network show Star Search in 2002–2003.

en.kicker: modern jazz singer and songwriter · star search, 2002–2003
